title: Permission withdrawn
story: Asha cancels ShopBot's permission in the wallet app. A few minutes later ShopBot, working through an old to-do list, tries to pay for groceries. The Guard blocks it with MANDATE_REVOKED: stop means stop, at once.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: (In the wallet app) I'm cancelling ShopBot's permission to pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Next on my list: the usual basket at FreshMart, INR 1,250. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

what_to_notice: The Mandate wasn't deleted or edited: revoking stamps who revoked it and when, and the Mandate snapshot in the Audit record shows both. A revoked Mandate can never be switched back on. To pay again, Asha would have to grant a new one.
